record.field: The engine is detecting that one cylinder is not firing properly. Common on the GME 2.0L. Most often caused by an aged ignition coil or fouled spark plug. Not immediately dangerous but should be addressed to prevent catalyst damage.
Ignition coil failure · Spark plug fouling · Fuel injector clog · Compression loss
Idle Air Control RPM Higher than Expected
The engine is idling faster than expected. Typically a vacuum leak or throttle body issue. Not safety-critical but contributes to fuel consumption.
Vacuum leak · Dirty throttle body · IAC valve issue
ABS is disabled. Braking distance will be longer especially in wet conditions. Do not drive aggressively. Contact AlfaCore immediately.
Wheel speed sensor failure · ABS module fault · Wiring harness damage
Brake booster pressure sensor failure. The brake pedal may feel harder than usual. Do not drive — request roadside.
Sensor failure · Vacuum hose disconnection · Booster diaphragm leak
Intake manifold runner control performance issue. Common on the 2.9 V6 Quadrifoglio. Affects performance under load but not safety.
Turbocharger is producing more boost pressure than expected. Continued driving in spirited conditions can damage the turbo or engine internals. Recommend immediate inspection.
